condition: 8 digest bits only; no message, length, target index or oracle lookup in generator. Dense existing hash BitDenoiser, width32 (internal128).
criterion: Independent oracle/evaluator agreement for every domain candidate/target prefix; no train/test message or digest overlap; correct prefix ordering; generated prefix match equals in-domain oracle membership; at least one valid held-out preimage at K=100. Zero preimages => FAIL, without config changes.
distribution: Uniform over 256 enumerated messages, digest-group split; toy only; does not replace main Printable94 distribution.
smoke: Train seed0 once, evaluate first three validation targets with K=10; integrity only, no efficacy adaptation.
validity: Codec valid AND exactly four bytes from ABCD; invalid and duplicates consume one attempt. No repair.
